Thewe's... mowe??? |[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 41 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Slow King''' was a slightly slow and tanky [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It is similar to the [[Mega Slow]], but has more health and faster speed. The '''Slow King''' also has [[Shield Health]], and this is attached to its forcefield that it spawns with. With this forcefield, the '''Slow King''' has a high defense value. Without its shield, it will be reduced to 10%, regardless of what defense it spawned with. If it loses defense, the defense it changes to will include the defense reduction. For example, if its defense got reduced from 80% to 75%, it will have 5% defense after losing all of its [[Shield Health]]. The '''Slow King''' also has [[Stun Immunity]], meaning that the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down, while knockback towers cannot knock it back. The '''Slow King''' can be spawned by the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]. The [[Mystery Boss]] can spawn the '''Slow King''' upon its death in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, wave 41 onwards. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current '''Slow King''' is similar to the previous version, except it has a huge slash across its face. When the '''Slow King''' spawns, it has a translucent pink forcefield surrounding it. This forcefield disappears when the '''Slow King''' loses its shield health. |Original |The original '''Slow King''' had green reflective skin. It had tumors on both arms. Its torso and legs were black granite, and it wore diamond-plated armbands. Its cape was black granite and had brown hooks on its shoulders. It wore a slightly tilted dark green granite crown, which indicates that this enemy was royalty. It emitted green particles from its torso and purple particles from its arms. On its torso, was a pink gem. It was faceless and had a twisted left leg. When the '''Slow King''' spawns, it has a translucent pink forcefield surrounding it. This forcefield disappears when the '''Slow King''' loses its shield health. }} ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *The forcefield around the '''Slow King''' can be problematic if not taken care of. This is because it gives the '''Slow King''' a very high defense value. **The [[Pursuit]] can be useful here because of its high DPS and its missiles dealing full damage to defense enemies. **While being relatively slow, it allows other enemies, like the [[Lava]] and [[Fallen Titan]], to go much further along the path. **Defense dropping towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Jester]] can be used to drop its defense, allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. *The [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] or [[Sledger]] can be used to slow this down. **Do note that due to its large size, freezing towers and the [[Warden]] will slow it down for a shorter amount of time. **The '''Slow King''' also has [[Stun Immunity]], which means that stunning towers like the [[Warden]] can only slow it down instead of stopping it completely while knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] cannot knock it back. *After the '''Slow King's''' forcefield disappears, other towers with high DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Ranger]], can be used to defeat the '''Slow King'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} SlowKingShield2.png|Second version with forcefield (8 May 2021) – 31 October 2025) SlowKing.png|First version without forcefield (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) SlowKingShield0.png|First version with forcefield (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSlowKing.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} OverhualUpdate.png|'''Slow King''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Entity System -
